description: A valid state appearance spec has unique component IDs, non-empty default states, no empty state objects, and at least one component declared.

rules.description: Every component must have a unique id. Duplicate component IDs cause ambiguous state lookups in the component library.
Every component's default state must declare at least one visual property. An empty default means the component has no styled baseline.
No state object can be completely empty. Either the state has visual properties or it should be removed from the spec. An empty state deceives reviewers into thinking coverage exists.
The spec must contain at least one component. An empty spec is a structural error.
